newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani force finds fake $10 mln at press.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani force finds fake $10 mln at press.

text.p: Pakistan's Anti-Narcotics Force (ANF) said on Monday it had seized fake dollars bills amounting to more than $10 million in a raid on a printing press in the Punjab province capital of Lahore.

The official APP news agency quoted an ANF spokesman as saying the raid took place on Friday but information about it was held back until Monday so the force could arrest people involved in the affair.
It was not immediately clear whether the dollar bills, which ANF regional director Brigadier Hussain Shah said were founded hidden in books, were printed at the Lahore press or elsewhere.
The action followed a tip-off that foreign currency was being used in drugs trafficking, Shah said.
He said the raiding party arrested printing press owner Ejaz Butt with two air tickets, indicating he had planned to go to the United Arab Emirates.
"We've also detained five to six other persons but two to three may have slipped out of our grasp after the leakage (of information) about this raid in a section of press," he said.
